findings.summary: Reuse Assert-PackageChild for staging cleanup and join_path for the Android payload directory.
Remove duplicate force-stop and redundant stream flushes.
Enable native caching, buffer log insertions under one lock and stream logcat once per smoke run.
Use the canonical entry source for desktop and Android target properties and cache includes.
Reuse parity thresholds, the bounded worker pool and atomic JSON records; tolerate transient Windows report readers.
Generate only selected scenes for focused runs, reuse decoded reference dimensions and count statuses in one pass.
Bound retained log chunks and search only new text plus a split-marker tail.
Prepare dependencies once for read-only parallel APK builds, serialize device capture and avoid packaging a bootstrap APK.
Share logged child-process execution across desktop shipping, Android shipping and the Android sweep.
Build engine option arguments explicitly and keep Android limits in Features.
Configure Android buffers only when creating the retained SDL window.
Derive the Android sweep dependency union from selected generated scenes through the canonical CMake feature rules.
Use one path-valued bootstrap option and pass the generated-directory list through a file to avoid Windows command-line limits.
Remove temporary dependency-test fixtures after checking their workspace boundary.
Reuse the package boundary assertion before replacing a RmlUi build tree.
Cache Android named-font metadata and family/weight results, including misses; resolve variations only for the selected face.
Reuse Android dependency artifacts using input fingerprints and required output checks.
Restrict RmlUi fingerprints to consumed dependency ABI records, which include their transitive inputs.
Keep Android CSS number parsing in one maintained RmlUi adapter and select Boost.Charconv only for UI.
Remove obsolete unsupported-feature classification after replacing blanket Android refusals with the system-font API requirement.
Extend the shared UI hit-testing rule with DOM listener element identities and transport only that native metadata across the Window mailbox.
Use canonical idle replay tokens and allow the blocked realm to acknowledge unblocking before the resize phase.
Reuse shared canvas metrics to convert Window DOM input at the actual SDL pixel density.
Share Window canvas hit selection between mouse and touch after coordinate conversion.
Compute touch hit positions directly in CSS client coordinates without a redundant scale round trip.
Retain the no-DOM fast path for camera-only touch input; camera contact tracking remains independent.
